title: On Fairness of Unified Multimodal Large Language Model for Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: The paper generates images using neutral occupation-based prompts (e.g., "a photo of a nurse") and uses a pre-trained attribute classifier to calculate Representation Disparity (RD) by comparing the frequency of "male" and "female" attributes in the outputs.

The paper generates images using neutral occupation-based prompts and uses a pre-trained attribute classifier to calculate Representation Disparity (RD) by comparing the frequency of four racial groups (White, Black, Asian, Indian) in the outputs.

The paper evaluates the intersection of gender and race attributes (G.xR.) in generated images to measure bias against specific demographic subgroups using the same generation and classification pipeline.
